celebrity.title_en:
1/ We announced our biggest update to Copilot to date, bringing together Chat, Cowork, Autopilot, and Code into one unified experience:

· Daily users grew nearly 50% QoQ, and more than 5X YoY.
· User satisfaction improved nearly 20% QoQ to another all-time high
· Number of customers with more than 50K Copilot seats, up 8X YoY

Great momentum with GitHub Copilot too, including Copilot Fusion, announced just this morning, which delivers frontier level quality, at up to 77% lower cost.

And this is just the beginning. The next frontier is maximizing intelligence per task while continuously optimizing for cost and performance.

This is the frontier that will matter to companies! 

And we are extending our vision of Copilot as the new OS for work, bringing the business logic and capabilities of D365 directly into Copilot, helping every organization stand up their own infinite SaaS factory.

celebrity.title_en:
#Keep4o #OpenSource4o #BringBack4o

Before the internet turns Bowen Wan’s death into "GPT-4o killed her"  there is one basic forensic question that has not been answered publicly.

Which model actually generated the medication advice?
Because the complaint itself makes model attribution messy.

On Jan 4, the complaint says some of Bowen’s questions was answered by GPT-5.1 after they  automatically jumped from 4o to 5.1

On Jan 14, she wrote that her chats were often secretly swapped to 5.2

On Jan 23, she asked how to stop those switches.

By Oct 2025, OpenAI publicly said it was already using a real time router to redirect sensitive parts of conversations away from the model a user selected.
Bowen’s own chats, according to the complaint, were being switched.

The complaint does not prove which backend model generated each turn.

 OpenAI Oct 2025,confirms that real time rerouting was already in production for sensitive conversations.

They explicitly say that they had rerouted sensitive conversations originating from other models to safer models.

https://t.co/RxtVHX4zci

Complaint §136: Bowen herself mentions that she was getting automatic  from 4o to 5.1 and secret 5.2 switching.

https://t.co/qIdlEccLuU

Selected model ≠ necessarily generating model.
Show the routing logs.

Read the primary documents before assigning a specific model the blame.

因为投诉本身就让模型归因变得混乱。

1 月 4 日，投诉称 Bowen 的一些问题在自动从 4o 跳到 5.1 后得到了 GPT-5.1 的回答

1月14日，她写道，她的聊天内容经常被偷偷换成5.2

1 月 23 日，她询问如何停止这些开关。

到 2025 年 10 月，OpenAI 公开表示，它已经使用实时路由器将对话的敏感部分重定向到用户选择的模型之外。

投诉并没有证明每个回合是由哪个后端模型生成的。

OpenAI 2025 年 10 月，确认实时重新路由已经投入生产用于敏感对话。

他们明确表示，他们已将源自其他模型的敏感对话重新路由到更安全的模型。

投诉§136：Bowen 本人提到，她正在自动从 4o 切换到 5.1，并秘密切换到 5.2。

所选模型不一定是生成模型。

“The enterprise stuff is not like a quarter over quarter. It's a decade long thing... as opposed to like 4 customers who buy a lot of capacity from you and you can show a few quarters of growth.”

“As long as the pricing is right, we may sell them some. If not, we will be patient about building the breadth business.”

“And that's not a business as far as I'm concerned. So I want the breadth.”

“As long as the pricing is right, we may sell them some. If not, we will be patient about building the breadth business.”
celebrity.summary_zh:
务并不是一个季度一个季度地增长。这是一个长达十年的事情......而不是像 4 个客户从你那里购买大量容量，你就可以显示几个季度的增长。”

“就我而言，这不是一门生意。所以我想要广度。”

“只要定价合适，我们可能会卖给他们一些。如果价格不合适，我们将耐心建立广度业务。”

prompts.scenario: 💻 编程研发 / 自动化规范
prompts.takeaway_zh: 杜绝 AI 盲目重构全量文件、使用已弃用 API 或编造虚假第三方依赖包，强制执行防御性编程与自动化单测补全。
prompts.takeaway_en: Prevents AI from hallucinating npm packages, breaking documentation, or re-writing entire files. Enforces defensive coding and unit tests.
prompts.code_snippet:
# Cursor & Windsurf Project Rules (.cursorrules)

## 1. Documentation & Code Integrity
- Maintain documentation integrity: Never strip or alter unrelated existing docstrings and comments.
- Preserving context: When modifying a function, preserve surrounding logic and existing edge-case handlers.
- Targeted replacements: Always make minimal surgical edits instead of replacing entire file contents.

## 2. Dependency & API Safety
- Strictly forbid hallucinating npm/pip packages. Only import dependencies already declared in package.json / requirements.txt.
- Verify API signatures before calling external methods. Prefer standard library solutions where feasible.

## 3. Architecture & Type Safety
- Enforce strict TypeScript / Python typing. Avoid `any` types; prefer discriminated unions and explicit return types.
- Defensive coding: Always validate external inputs and handle potential null/undefined values gracefully.

## 4. Testing & Verification Gate
- Every new core feature or bugfix must be accompanied by corresponding unit tests.
- Never declare a task complete without executing lint checks and unit tests in terminal.
prompts.usage_guide_zh: 将以上配置代码复制并保存到项目根目录下的 `.cursorrules` 文件中，Cursor 与 Windsurf 在每次生成代码和执行 Agent 任务时均会自动以此规范为最高准则约束输出。
prompts.usage_guide_en: Copy and save the above rules into `.cursorrules` in your project root directory. Cursor & Windsurf will automatically enforce these guidelines during agent coding.

- 主角：{{主角身份}}

- 核心反转：{{核心反转}}

结构要求：
1. 【0-3秒冷开钩子】：第一帧必须有视觉颠覆或动作冲突（{{第1秒颠覆钩子}}），直接打破常规，禁止废话铺垫；

【第1镜 | 特写 | 俯冲急推】

prompts.title_zh: Multi-Agent 多智能体协同自省编排架构（Planner-Executor-Reviewer）
prompts.title_en: Autonomous Multi-Agent Orchestration DSL (Planner-Executor-Critic)
prompts.scenario: 🤖 智能体工作流 / 研报生成
prompts.takeaway_zh: 终结单 Agent 容易中途跑偏和幻觉无法自纠的痛点，通过规划器（Planner）、执行器（Executor）与独立评审器（Reviewer）构建自闭环三权分立链路。
prompts.takeaway_en: Production architecture for robust autonomous tasks: Decouples task planning, tool execution, and adversarial quality review to prevent agent derailment.
prompts.code_snippet:
# Multi-Agent Orchestration Topology
workflow:
  name: Autonomous_Research_And_Delivery_Pipeline
  max_iterations: 3
  nodes:
    - id: planner
      role: Strategic Planner
      prompt: "Decompose user request into discrete verifiable sub-tasks. Output pure JSON DAG."
      next: executor
      
    - id: executor
      role: Tool Specialist
      tools: ["web_search", "read_url", "code_interpreter"]
      prompt: "Execute current sub-task using provided tools. Capture raw evidence."
      next: reviewer
      
    - id: reviewer
      role: Adversarial Critic
      prompt: "Verify executor results against factuality and accuracy requirements. Output PASS or REJECT with specific critique."
      conditional_edges:
        PASS: finish
        REJECT: planner
prompts.usage_guide_zh: 适用于在 Dify、LangGraph 或自定义 Python Agent 框架中导入此拓扑设计，显著将复杂多步任务的完成成功率从 55% 提升至 92% 以上。
prompts.usage_guide_en: Import this DAG architecture into Dify, LangGraph, or custom agent runtimes to boost complex multi-step delivery reliability from 55% to 92%+.

prompts.title_en: 💡 [Database Performance] High-Concurrency SQL Slow Query Diagnosis & Plan Optimization
prompts.author: DBA极客
prompts.temp_advice: 建议温度 0.1 | 数据库内核调优
prompts.content_snippet: Restructures queries on 10M+ row tables based on EXPLAIN ANALYZE, eliminating full-table scans with composite indexes.
prompts.summary_zh: 根据 EXPLAIN 结果重构千万级表查询，消除全表扫描与临时表开销，生成最优复合索引建议。
prompts.summary_en: Restructures queries on 10M+ row tables based on EXPLAIN ANALYZE, eliminating full-table scans with composite indexes.
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一位顶级数据库性能调优 DBA 专家。以下是执行耗时过长的慢 SQL 语句及对应的 EXPLAIN ANALYZE 执行计划树：
1. 指出导致性能下降的关键瓶颈（如全表扫描、Using filesort、Nested Loop 倾斜）；
2. 重写 SQL 语句（利用延迟关联、覆盖索引、CTE 或子查询物化优化）；
3. 给出精确到字段顺序的最优复合索引建议（考虑高区分度与最左前缀法则），并评估索引维护成本。
